title: Event
description: TiloEvent v1 (PRD 9.3). The harness is the only writer and one writer per world gives seq strictly increasing per world. type is any family.verb so that a newer type still parses (HR-5: an unknown type renders in the Trace only), but the harness emits registered types only, and data must match that type's schema in contracts/events/data/. Registry rules EV-01 to EV-16 are in contracts/event.rules.md. A side-effect type (registry side_effect: true) carries authz; the list in this schema's if equals the registry's and contracts-check fails if they drift. A policy never authorises a T3 action.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per world; the harness is the one writer per world.

summary.description: Plain-language line for the Story lens and tooltips.

cause.description: Id of the event that caused this one, for the Trace causation chain.

authz.description: Who authorised it (BQ-01). Required on side-effect types; null otherwise.

data.description: Type-specific payload; its schema is contracts/events/data/<type>.schema.json.

if.description: EV-03: every side-effect type carries authz (PRD 10.4 Audit, FR-HIL-08). This list equals the types registry.yaml marks side_effect: true.
EV-07: T3 always needs a person (PRD 10.4), so an event authorised by a policy never carries a T3 risk tier in its data. Only side-effect types carry authz (EV-05).

family_verb.description: family.verb in lower case, e.g. agent.context_handoff_started.

actor.description: Who caused it: a person, an agent, a Team Lead, a policy, or system for the platform itself (scheduler, sweeper, connector monitor).

target.description: What it affected: a world, level, district, building, plan unit, gate, island, agent, artifact, person, Team Lead or policy.

item.description: A carried item the world draws (PRD 9.3).

item_kind.description: What the world draws, from the PRD 9.5 world effects: document (a work item an agent carries), crate and scroll (data over a bridge), parcel (a deliverable), blueprint (an approach), note (an answer), decision (a meeting decision card), backpack (a context handoff note).

vis.description: Server-side redaction scope (PRD 10.1, 15.3): all, or the districts whose viewers may see it; a list includes the event's own district (EV-13). An empty list (1.2.0, ADR-0009) puts the event in no scoped view: only the owner's full stream carries it (owner-only, for example a Desk-world event, PE-12, or a card with no known district, BQ-69). It is allowed only when district is null (EV-13). Never null: a writer must not default a missing vis.

trace.description: Trace lens columns (PRD 9.6). Each required field is null when the event made no model or tool call. tokens_cached (1.1.0, EFF-04, ADR-0022) is optional: left out means unknown, never zero; when present, tokens_in is a number and tokens_cached is at most tokens_in (EV-16).

model_role.description: Role name from config/models.yaml, never a model id.

profile.description: Profile name from config/models.yaml, never a model id.

tokens_in.description: Every input token the model calls behind this event processed, cached tokens included (ADR-0022).

tool.description: Tool or connector action called, e.g. send_email.

tokens_cached.description: Input tokens the provider served from its prompt cache, a part of tokens_in (EFF-04, ADR-0022). Set only when the provider reported a cached count for every model call behind this event; 0 is a reported miss. Left out means unknown, never zero; never null.

archive_ref.description: Raw archive record (PRD 13.2): <run id>/<record seq in that run's archive>.

answer_source.description: Who answered a question or meeting (BQ-04): a person, a Team Lead, the card's safe default applied at timeout, or an earlier decision (FR-AGT-07). Never a model's own choice.
